title: Three Minute Polyrhythm Prompt Modulation
base_runway_rules: Cinematic dynamic landscape, strong camera movement, photoreal high detail, no people, no logos, no readable text, no captions.

slots.label: Tension chords
slots.magenta_prompt: evolving complex jazzy tension chords, warm electric piano, altered dominants, chromatic voice leading, suspended ninths, sharp elevens, thirteenths, deep harmonic bass foundation
slots.visual_language: warm harmonic architecture, amber and copper light planes, stacked chord-like cliffs, glowing terraces, slow harmonic color changes

slots.label: Glassy arpeggios
slots.magenta_prompt: fast glassy arpeggio figures, crystalline mallets, syncopated upper-register patterns, bright modal runs, shimmering rhythmic motion
slots.visual_language: crystalline arpeggio energy, prismatic ice rivers, thin light trails, fast ascending reflective patterns, clean kinetic details

slots.label: Broken beat drums
slots.magenta_prompt: dry broken beat drums, tight room, crisp rim clicks, syncopated jazz break, fractured kick patterns, late-night club pulse
slots.visual_language: syncopated terrain cuts, punchy camera accelerations, rhythmic shadow blocks, tight contrast, percussive edits

slots.label: Granular texture
slots.magenta_prompt: granular tape texture and vinyl air, misty noise bed, soft degraded ambience, analog dust, drifting harmonic fog
slots.visual_language: granular tape atmosphere, fog layers, film grain, analog color bleed, drifting dust, warped parallax

sections.label: Intro
sections.runway_scene: pre-dawn mountain valley above cloud, very slow drone push, distant water and fog, warm harmonic light barely appearing

sections.label: Pulse Entry
sections.runway_scene: camera descends into the valley, glassy streams and reflective ridges appear, first rhythmic cuts in terrain and shadow

sections.label: Harmony Expansion
sections.runway_scene: wide canyon flight, stacked terraces and glowing chord-like planes unfold, camera sweeps around cliffs and water

sections.label: First Peak
sections.runway_scene: fast drone rush through crystalline valley structures, rhythmic shadows and bright arpeggio trails cross the camera

sections.label: Modulation Spiral
sections.runway_scene: storm of harmonic light, fog, crystal trails, and percussive terrain pulses, camera rotates and dives through layered mountain space

sections.label: Final Peak
sections.runway_scene: largest reveal of the valley, radiant harmonic architecture and kinetic crystal lines, sweeping camera rise into sunset

sections.label: Outro
sections.runway_scene: camera leaves the valley into fading fog and warm residual light, harmonic structures dissolve into granular mist
